command07.name: WMS-675 real incident recovery on isolated PostgreSQL
command07.command:
# Keep the frozen Docker-aware database identity guard and bind the
# service alias only to this runner's published loopback port.
echo '127.0.0.1 postgres' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts
python -c "import socket; assert set(socket.gethostbyname_ex('postgres')[2]) == {'127.0.0.1'}"
python -c "import psycopg; c = psycopg.connect('postgresql://postgres:fixture-only@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres', autocommit=True); c.execute('CREATE DATABASE wms_test_675_incident'); c.close()"
pytest -n 0 -q -s tests/test_wms675_recovery_scenario.py --junitxml="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-postgres/675.xml"
